The best answer is **B, restrictive covenant**. The recorded plan limits the 10-acre lot to school use, which is a land-use restriction that lot buyers relied on, and "restrictive covenant" is the broader category that includes equitable servitudes. I'm moving off my earlier answer of A because equitable servitudes are usually negative restrictions enforced in equity, and this one is closer to an affirmative school-use obligation, so the broader term fits better. C is the main alternative if the restriction is treated as an affirmative obligation that cannot be enforced.

CONFIDENCE: 50
